## A
⚠️  LARGE PAGE SETUP REQUIRES RESTART
=====================================
The Large Page privilege has been configured but requires a restart to take effect.

Choose your preferred action:
  A) Exit TMR and restart system (RECOMMENDED for optimal performance)
  B) Continue with standard 4KB pages (~5-10% slower, so less memory stress)

Enter your choice (A/B): 
✅ Restart recommended for optimal performance.
After restart, TMR will automatically use large pages.

To restart:
  • Windows: shutdown /r /t 0
  • Or use Start Menu → Power → Restart

TMR will exit now.

## B
⚠️  LARGE PAGE SETUP REQUIRES RESTART
=====================================
The Large Page privilege has been configured but requires a restart to take effect.

Choose your preferred action:
  A) Exit TMR and restart system (RECOMMENDED for optimal performance)
  B) Continue with standard 4KB pages (~5-10% slower, so less memory stress)

Enter your choice (A/B): 
⚠️  Continuing with standard 4KB pages (minpage=regular for this run).
   Performance impact: ~5-10% slower than large pages
   Every test still runs and every pattern is still checked, but slower
   memory traffic is less stress, so marginal errors that only appear at
   full bandwidth may go undetected

💡 TIP: Restart TMR after rebooting for optimal performance
